misc: Primary organizer of the Hector Trophée event.
biography: Toni, representing Hirsala Golf, is a figure inextricably linked with the Hector Trophée. As the primary organizer of this esteemed annual competition, his commitment extends far beyond the administrative duties. He is also a formidable competitor, having graced every single edition of the tournament since its inception, with the upcoming Hector Trophée 2026 marking his impressive thirteenth appearance.

His prowess on the course is as notable as his dedication to its organization. Throughout his twelve prior participations, Toni has demonstrated exceptional skill and competitive fire, securing the coveted Hector Trophée for his pair on three separate occasions. Furthermore, his individual excellence has been recognized twice with the prestigious Victor Trophy, cementing his status among the tournament's most decorated players.

A meticulous planner and strategist, both in the boardroom and on the fairway, Toni's approach to golf is characterized by a thoughtful precision. This innate drive for perfection, coupled with a calm demeanor under pressure, has been a hallmark of his enduring success. As he prepares for his thirteenth outing, the golf community eagerly anticipates whether this architect of the tournament can once again etch his name onto the leaderboard, adding another chapter to his already legendary Hector Trophée narrative.
